name: gogi
description: Gōgi (合議) — a Claude Code plugin that runs any engineering request as a small council of roles that agree before anyone acts.

plugins.name: gogi
plugins.description: Intent-routed multi-agent team: coordinator (coordinates only) + scout (sonnet) + monitor (sonnet, owns the heartbeat) + dev + techlead + po (PO/BA) + investigator, with least-code-that-works (stop order, --lean level, over-build review, slim intent), agreement-before-code, an autonomy level (low/high/full), per-agent worklogs with context-budget rotation, frozen-tree reviews, run knowledge hub, comms log, token stats and learned user preferences.
